title: Three paintings in the autumn issue
body:
*Coastline Quarterly* ran three of the harbor paintings in its autumn issue, alongside a short essay on working from memory instead of from photographs.

The editors chose the larger harbor study for the opening spread. It started as a ten-minute sketch on the pier in March and took most of the summer to finish.

The issue is on newsstands through December, and the full essay is [online at Coastline Quarterly](https://example.com/autumn-issue).
